interface Proxy0
    description XRAY-NL
    security-level public
    ip global 3
    proxy protocol socks5
    proxy upstream 127.0.0.1 1082
    up
!
interface Proxy1
    description XRAY-SMART-RU
    security-level public
    ip global 2
    proxy protocol socks5
    proxy upstream 127.0.0.1 1083
    up
!
interface Proxy2
    description XRAY-US
    security-level public
    ip global 1
    proxy protocol socks5
    proxy upstream 127.0.0.1 1084
    up
!
ip policy Policy0
    description VPN-NL
    permit global Proxy0
    no permit global PPPoE0
    no permit global Proxy1
    no permit global Proxy2
!
ip policy Policy1
    description VPN-SMART-RU
    permit global Proxy1
    no permit global PPPoE0
    no permit global Proxy0
    no permit global Proxy2
!
ip policy Policy2
    description VPN-US
    permit global Proxy2
    no permit global PPPoE0
    no permit global Proxy0
    no permit global Proxy1
!
ip hotspot
